newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Handball-Nigeria seek court order to stop tournaments.
newsitem.headline: Handball-Nigeria seek court order to stop tournaments.

text.p: Nigeria said on Tuesday it will seek an international court order to stop the Confederation of African Handball (CAHB) from organising two tournaments if the continental body fails to meet its demand of a $125,000 refund.

The Nigeria Handball Federation (NHF) allege the amount of money was used by four of its men's and women's club sides to prepare for the African Men and Women Handball Clubs Championships in December which were not held.
CAHB postponed both tournaments and moved the venue from Morocco to Algeria without informing the teams in time, NHF said.
Lanre Glover, NHF president, said: "In fact, our teams were already in Egypt en route to Algeria, when we were told that both tournaments have been postponed and the venue changed again."
"We have already protested to the International Handball Federation, demanding it compel CAHB to refund to us $125,000 spent for preparing for the tournaments," Glover said.
"If our demand is not met, we'll get an international court order to stop CAHB from organising both tournaments."
CAHB said it has re-scheduled both tournaments for February 14-25 in Cotonou, Benin Republic.
